description: Executable Candidate single-Spark recipe for NVIDIA's Nemotron-Labs-3 Puzzle 75B-A9B NVFP4 checkpoint (modelopt mixed precision, MTP head), following MiaAI-Lab's Nemotron-Labs-3-Puzzle-75B-DGX-Spark launcher: stock vLLM v0.24.0 arm64 image pinned by digest with upstream's aarch64 NCCL and FlashInfer patches applied at build time, expert parallel, flashinfer Mamba backend and FLASHINFER_CUTLASS MoE, FP8 KV cache, MTP k=3, qwen3_coder tool parser, nemotron_v3 reasoning parser, prefix caching, eager mode, 256K context and 7 sequences. Upstream warns the first start can take several minutes while FlashInfer kernels compile. Code: no licence file upstream; model: NVIDIA OpenMDW-1.1, not gated. Vonk physical Spark acceptance is pending; upstream publishes no throughput figures. Not expressed: upstream's SPEC-empty switch (MTP off) cannot be offered because a choice cannot remove an argument, and the docker-level flags (privileged, memory cap, cache mounts) are platform-owned. GB10 memory correction: Per-node peak budgets utilization × 130,663,231,488-byte unified memory plus at least 8 GB for CUDA context/graphs, FlashInfer workspace, auxiliary heads and CPU/mmap buffers; 8 GB reserve, with a separate 6 GB OS floor. This is a conservative budget, not a measured footprint.
title: Nemotron Labs 3 Puzzle 75B-A9B NVFP4 vLLM one Spark (Mia)
